headline: Have I Been Pwned indexed about 3.6 million email addresses tied to Careers360, and about $13.5 million in XMR1 sales drove Wagyu’s token down to roughly $1. Bell Canada reported theft of enterprise customer data, and the European Commission said it had restored most applications taken offline after an October cyberattack.

incidents.what: Have I Been Pwned indexed data attributed to the education platform, including student exam results and contact information; how it was obtained is unknown.
Sales from tokens moved out of Wagyu's deployer account drove XMR1 to about $1; the operator attributed the compromise to a hosting breach.
Binance said recovery efforts continue without disclosing a recovered total, while monitors reported further movements of assets tied to the October theft.
CISA added CVE-2026-123890 to its catalog after the authentication bypass was reported exploited in attacks.
CISA added CVE-2026-76466 to its catalog after researchers reported that attackers used it to compromise devices and reach an internal network.
CISA added CVE-2025-42884, an actively exploited flaw that can expose or allow changes to server information in NetWeaver Enterprise Portal.
Bell said an intruder stole enterprise customer data after accessing systems including a circuit-provisioning environment, but did not disclose how the intruder entered.
Chase and Mastercard reported customer marketing data or email exposure at vendors, while Visa said a provider incident did not affect payment data.
Have I Been Pwned indexed data attributed to the music distributor, including password hashes and identity information in some records.
Multiple applications taken offline over several days in response to a cybersecurity incident.
The Commission said it had restored most applications taken offline after an AI-assisted campaign and had found no evidence of a breach affecting staff as a whole.
The legislature took some IT systems offline during a cyberattack that also disrupted its website and had not spread to other state agencies.
